usage: Used for the outer covering of a tree; it’s a very common nature/gardening noun.
Often appears in simple descriptive phrases with verbs like ‘摸’, ‘剝’, and ‘保護’ when talking about trees.
Can be used in both everyday speech and basic science/nature contexts; no special register.
For learners, it usually refers to the hard outer layer of a tree trunk, not the skin of animals or people.
